name: Krzysztof Nowak
title: Senior Solutions Consultant
summary: Highly accomplished Senior Solutions Consultant with over 8 years of experience in designing, architecting, and delivering complex enterprise solutions. Proven expertise in presales engineering, business analysis, and client engagement across diverse industries. Drives business growth by translating intricate technical requirements into comprehensive, value-driven strategies and implementations.

bullets: Led over 25 successful presales engagements, securing deals worth an average of $500K by demonstrating tailored technical solutions to C-level executives and technical stakeholders.
Architected and presented end-to-end cloud and on-premise solutions for enterprise clients, resulting in a 20% increase in solution adoption rates year-over-year.
Collaborated with product development teams to translate client feedback and market needs into new features, influencing product roadmap and enhancing competitive advantage.
Mentored junior consultants, improving team efficiency and knowledge sharing, which contributed to a 15% reduction in project onboarding time.
Designed and implemented custom CRM and ERP integrations for 10+ major clients, improving operational efficiency by an average of 18%.
Conducted comprehensive business analysis and discovery workshops to identify client pain points and define solution scopes, leading to a 95% client satisfaction rate on initial proposals.
Developed detailed solution architectures, functional specifications, and technical documentation, ensuring seamless handover to implementation teams.
Provided post-implementation support and optimization recommendations, contributing to long-term client retention and upselling opportunities.
Assisted in the deployment and configuration of enterprise software solutions for clients in finance and manufacturing sectors.
Performed data migration and system integration tasks, ensuring data integrity and minimal downtime during transitions.
Conducted user training sessions and developed training materials for new software functionalities, empowering end-users to maximize system utility.
Troubleshot complex technical issues and provided timely resolution, maintaining high levels of client operational continuity.
